title: Quenched Pork Wholesome Croquettes
description: This malty, dense Quenched Pork Wholesome Croquette recipe is a perfect solo-dinner dish from Croatia. Whole30-friendly and packed with shredded meat, this croquette will be the star of your dinner table.
instructions: Combine pork shoulder, potato starch, garlic powder, ginger paste, paprika, sesame oil, salt, and pepper in a bowl.
Shape the mixture into croquettes of your desired size.
Heat a pan on medium-high heat. Add enough sesame oil to cover the bottom of the pan.
Place each croquette in the pan and fry until golden brown on all sides, about 3 minutes per side.
Transfer the croquettes to a serving dish and serve immediately.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
